# JuegoMania — Spanish cheat reference

- Original source: [JuegoMania — Spanish cheat reference](https://www.juegomania.org/pc/4000/robin-hood-the-legend-of-sherwood-pc-4000)
- Author / publication: JuegoMania
- Language / date: Spanish; date unverified
- Access: Indexed cheat list inspected
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

The retrieved list includes BINGO for ammunition, CASH for money, IMMUNITY for invulnerability, MERRYMAN for a recruit, TIMELESS for stopping time, UNBLIP for revealing characters, and WINNER for completing a mission.

**Research use:** a Spanish-language reference for cheat-command spellings and claimed effects.

**Limitations:** activation prerequisites, command interpretation, and compatibility across releases were not checked. The listing's description of GOODLUCK is ambiguous, so no effect is assigned here. A trainer is advertised on the page but was not downloaded. The site explicitly says no editorial or community analysis is present; it should not be indexed as a review.

## Trucos, Códigos y Secretos

1 trucos disponibles

⚡ Guía de Códigos y Secretos 

👍 Útil (1)  📋 Copiar 

CODIGOS  
Durante el juego, haz que tu personaje se arrodille sobre el puntero sobre el icono. Pulsa F11 para abrir la consola y podras meter los siguientes trucos:  
BINGO : 999 de municion para tus personajes.  
CASH : Conseguir dinero.  
GOODLUCK : Buen aspecto.  
IMMUNITY : Activa modo Dios.  
MERRYMAN : Conseguir un hombre alegre.  
PAM : Activa enemigos dummy para combate cercano.  
TIMELESS : Parar el reloj.  
UNBLIP : Ver todos los personajes en el mapa.  
WINNER : Ganar la mision actual.
